paper_title: Investigating the gamma-ray burst from decaying MeV-scale axion-like particles produced in supernova explosions
notes: Paper derives an updated SN 1987A gamma-ray decay bound on the ALP-photon coupling g_agamma, extending the excluded mass range up to m_a ~ 280 MeV by including photon coalescence production. Main new result is the observed SMM/SN1987A exclusion (2 sigma and 3 sigma); a Fermi-LAT sensitivity projection (down to g_agamma ~ 1e-13 GeV^-1) is also presented but is secondary. No numerical table is provided; the exclusion contour is only shown in Fig. 3. Data points here are ROUGH estimates of the lower boundary of the excluded band inferred from text-quoted benchmark values (case 1: g=1e-11 GeV^-1, m=1 MeV 'close to maximal allowed'; case 2: g=4e-13 GeV^-1, m=100 MeV, factor ~5 below the edge). Values should be treated as approximate. Astrophysical bound - no DM density applies. Bound extends from ~10 keV to ~280 MeV. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.42, 4))
